fiscal.title: Fiscal Health
fiscal.description: Documents currently in contingency or rejected state. Retry pushes a fresh attempt to the provider.

retry.noPermission: Only admins can retry fiscal documents.
retry.confirmMessage: This re-arms the fiscal outbox row so the worker pushes it to the provider again.

intent.title: Invoices not created yet
intent.description: Durable sale obligations waiting for fiscal numbering. No number or CUFE is invented before this step succeeds.
intent.empty: Every fiscal obligation has produced a document.
intent.noPermission: Only admins can recheck fiscal obligations.

reason.unknown: Review fiscal configuration and try again.
reason.numbering_resolution_missing: No matching numbering resolution is available.
reason.numbering_resolution_changed: The frozen numbering resolution changed after the sale.
reason.numbering_resolution_not_effective: The numbering resolution was not effective when the sale completed.
reason.sale_lines_missing: The frozen sale has no fiscal lines.
reason.tax_header_mismatch: The fiscal header does not reconcile with its frozen lines.
reason.adapter_configuration_invalid: The frozen provider configuration is invalid.
reason.adapter_configuration_validation_failed: Provider configuration could not be validated.
reason.fiscal_provider_changed: The active provider no longer matches the frozen sale contract.
reason.original_dee_not_accepted: Waiting for the original invoice to be accepted before issuing the credit note.
reason.original_dee_changed: The original invoice reference no longer matches its frozen value.
reason.original_dee_contract_changed: The original invoice uses a different country or provider contract.
reason.FISCAL_INTENT_MATERIALIZATION_FAILED: Document creation failed and remains safely queued.

emptyState.contingency: No fiscal documents are currently in contingency.
emptyState.rejected: No fiscal documents are currently in rejected state.
emptyState.accepted: No accepted fiscal documents in the recent window.
